title: FlowDoc Product Evidence Refresh
summary: Refresh the cross-repository product evidence packet for the current Core, Editor, and Backend heads before any product-wide truth promotion.
expectedOutput: A bounded evidence packet that records current repository heads, verification results, promotion blockers, and follow-on remediation targets without changing product runtime behavior.
riskSummary: Fresh test output can support an evidence packet, but failed or flaky gates must keep Core, Editor, Backend, and product-wide FlowDoc truth unpromoted.
